newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian finds out he died 11 years ago.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian finds out he died 11 years ago.

text.p: A Brazilian shopowner has found out he is officially dead, declared deceased by his former wife after they separated 11 years ago, Globo News television reported.

Avacir Avila of Rosario do Ivai in southern Brazil has since remarried and found out about his status when he approached authorities about adopting a boy, Globo said. His death had been confirmed by two witnesses and his ex-wife even went to his funeral.

His lawyer says Avila will have to prove he is still alive through fingerprinting and exhumation of the body that was buried in his name, the television said. Comment on the report from Avila and officials was not immediately available.
